about_the_game:
SLAY NIGHTMARES

The Dream Realm is infested with horrors born from fear, regret, and chaos—Nightmares that twist reality and hunt without mercy. They take many forms, shifting and evolving with the emotions that birthed them, making each encounter unpredictable and deadly. In Dream Slayers, your mission is clear: confront the darkness, wield medieval might, and slay what lurks beyond the veil. Every Nightmare stands between you and the truth hidden deep within the dream, from cursed knights to shadow beasts stitched from broken memories. Victory earns power, knowledge, and glory—but failure means losing everything. Every Nightmare you defeat brings you one step closer to mastering the dream… or being consumed by it.

EXTRACT

In Dream Slayers, extraction isn't just the endgame—it's survival. Every raid into the fractured dreamworld is a gamble, offering the chance to seize rare relics, arcane weapons, and fragments of forgotten knowledge. But with every step deeper into the dream, the Nightmares grow stronger, the world grows stranger, and the line between hunter and hunted begins to blur. Time your escape, manage your resources, and decide what to carry and leave behind. Trust your instincts, watch your allies' backs, and move fast—because in the end, only what you extract becomes real, and everything else is lost to the void.

RECRUIT AN ARMY

This new reality is ruthless, unpredictable, and filled with terrors no one should face alone. In Dream Slayers, you don’t just fight for survival—you build a legacy with your squad. Team up with friends to form your band of Slayers, each bringing unique skills, gear, and strategy to the fight. Coordinate assaults, cover each other during extraction, and take down the most formidable Nightmares together. The deeper the dream, the tougher the challenge—but even the impossible becomes winnable with the right allies. In this world, loyalty isn’t optional—it’s everything.
